description: Transaction receipt on Linea (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in ETH, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use linea_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x638169f15ccab7f5491b46b3a883fa1aa5b5399ba5c56fa0110355d47a526a93. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: linea_receipt
title: Linea transaction receipt
